zh: 网购进货。SuXin Warehouse · 拼多多 / 淘宝 / Shopee / TikTok
en: Stock bought online, as a purchase order

zh: 在购物 app 打开订单，全选复制
en: Copy the order from the shopping app
Paste it, press Read the order

zh: 商品、数量、价钱、运费、订单号都读出来了
en: Items, quantities, prices, shipping, order number — read for you

zh: 自动配对你的商品；下次同一样会记得
en: Matched to your products, and remembered next time

zh: 人民币按汇率换成 RM，运费算进成本
en: Yuan converted to ringgit, shipping added to the cost

zh: 变成采购单：已下单，等包裹
en: Now a purchase order, waiting for the parcel

zh: 包裹到了：扫运单号，打开这张单收货
en: Parcel here: scan its tracking number to receive it
